subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The movie theater changed from paper tickets to digital tickets.”?
options: Consumers began comparing scores before buying phones, laptops, and appliances.
Sometimes a small business can feed more than customers.
Customers only had to show a code on their phones.
A good map does not only show where places are.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Consumers began comparing scores before buying phones, laptops, and appliances.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes a small business can feed more than customers.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Customers only had to show a code on their phones.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A good map does not only show where places are.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Customers only had to show a code on their phones.」，答案為「Customers only had to show a code on their phones.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Customers only had to show a code on their phones.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
